vulnerability.name: CVE-2022-1650
vulnerability.description: Improper Removal of Sensitive Information Before Storage or Transfer in GitHub repository eventsource/eventsource (Node.js npm package) prior to v2.0.2.

statements.impact_statement: CVE-2022-1650 is registered against the Node.js npm package `eventsource` (NVD CPE: cpe:2.3:a:eventsource:eventsource:*:*:*:*:node.js:*:*:*). Grype matches it against the Swift package at https://github.com/mattt/eventsource (pulled in transitively via modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk) solely on package name. The Swift `eventsource` is an unrelated Server-Sent Events client for Apple platforms. It does not contain the vulnerable Node.js code path. This is a Grype package-name-collision false positive across ecosystems.
